# Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates

Gemini Omni and personal avatars in Google Vids make video creation easier than ever.

Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates Jul 16, 2026 | x.com Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Gemini Omni and personal avatars in Google Vids make video creation easier than ever. Now you can generate and edit high-quality clips using everyday language, and create a custom digital avatar to star in your videos. Justin Luk Product Manager Share x.com Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Your browser does not support the audio element. Listen to article [[duration]] minutes This content is generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental Voice Speed Voice Speed 0.75X 1X 1.5X 2X Read AI-generated summary Google Vids now features Gemini Omni, which lets you generate and edit high-quality videos using simple text prompts and image references. You can also create a digital avatar to deliver messages for you by uploading a selfie and a voice recording. Check your eligibility for these tools and start experimenting with your next video project today. Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental. Google Vids just added two new features to help you create better videos faster. Use Gemini Omni to generate or edit high-quality clips with simple text prompts. Easily swap backgrounds or fix lighting by just describing what you want to change. Create a digital avatar to star in videos without needing a camera or recording. Every AI-generated clip includes a digital watermark to keep your content transparent and honest. Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental. Google Vids now uses AI to help you make videos just by typing what you want to see. You can even edit your clips by simply describing the changes you need. If you don't want to be on camera, you can create a digital avatar that looks and sounds like you. Every AI-made video gets a special watermark so people know it was generated. Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental. Explore other styles: General summary Bullet points Basic explainer Today, we’re rolling out two new updates to Google Vids to make it easier than ever to create, edit and personalize your videos: Gemini Omni and personal avatars. Gemini Omni takes the hard work out of the editing process, so generating and refining high-quality clips is as easy as writing a simple prompt. And with personal avatars, you have an entirely new way to star in videos without setting up a camera.Here’s a look at how these new tools transform video creation.Generate videos from text and imagesIn the past year, you’ve created millions of videos in Google Vids to share your stories and bring your ideas to life. In February, we made the process simpler by rolling out Veo 3.1 to all users, helping everyone generate videos within Vids. Now, we’re bringing Gemini Omni to Vids, so you can create and edit high-quality videos just by describing what you want to see. Start with a simple text prompt in natural language, and add image references — like a photo or a rough sketch — for more detail. Omni mixes your inputs to generate a video that matches your vision.Chat to edit, step-by-stepGetting a video exactly right often requires a few tweaks after that first draft — and making those edits is now as easy as describing what you want to see. Whether you're refining a video you generated with Omni or a clip you shot on your phone, you can use everyday language to prompt Vids to swap backgrounds, fix lighting or add effects. Because Omni supports step-by-step edits, you can now make changes to your videos without starting from scratch.Star in videos, instantlyWant to send a quick video update or personalized shout-out, but don't have time to get camera-ready? With new personal avatars, you can create a digital avatar that looks and sounds like you. Just upload a selfie and a short voice recording. From there, type what you want to say and your avatar will deliver the message — no recording required. Gemini Omni and personal avatars are available in Google Vids for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and Google Workspace business customers. Access to personal avatars is currently limited to users in certain regions who are 18 or older. Personal avatars are linked to a user’s Google Account and are restricted to the account holder’s likeness.Create and share with transparencyWe want you to feel confident sharing what you create. To ensure content transparency, every generated clip includes an invisible SynthID digital watermark. This allows people to verify that a video was created with AI, so you can explore your creativity and share your AI videos responsibly.Come see what you can create with Gemini Omni and personal avatars in Google Vids. Get the latest news from Google in your inbox Sign up for our newsletters with product updates, event information, special offers, and more. Done. Just one step more. Check your inbox to confirm your subscription. You can also subscribe with a different email address. Your information will be used in accordance with Google's privacy policy. You may opt out at any time. POSTED IN:

Today, we’re rolling out two new updates to Google Vids to make it easier than ever to create, edit and personalize your videos: Gemini Omni and personal avatars. Gemini Omni takes the hard work out of the editing process, so generating and refining high-quality clips is as easy as writing a simple prompt. And with personal avatars, you have an entirely new way to star in videos without setting up a camera.

Here’s a look at how these new tools transform video creation.

Generate videos from text and images

In the past year, you’ve created millions of videos in Google Vids to share your stories and bring your ideas to life. In February, we made the process simpler by rolling out Veo 3.1 to all users, helping everyone generate videos within Vids.

analysis.extractedText:
Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates

Chat to edit, step-by-step

Getting a video exactly right often requires a few tweaks after that first draft — and making those edits is now as easy as describing what you want to see. Whether you're refining a video you generated with Omni or a clip you shot on your phone, you can use everyday language to prompt Vids to swap backgrounds, fix lighting or add effects.

Because Omni supports step-by-step edits, you can now make changes to your videos without starting from scratch.

Star in videos, instantly

Want to send a quick video update or personalized shout-out, but don't have time to get camera-ready? With new personal avatars, you can create a digital avatar that looks and sounds like you. Just upload a selfie and a short voice recording. From there, type what you want to say and your avatar will deliver the message — no recording required.

Gemini Omni and personal avatars are available in Google Vids for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and Google Workspace business customers. Access to personal avatars is currently limited to users in certain regions who are 18 or older. Personal avatars are linked to a user’s Google Account and are restricted to the account holder’s likeness.

Create and share with transparency

We want you to feel confident sharing what you create. To ensure content transparency, every generated clip includes an invisible SynthID digital watermark. This allows people to verify that a video was created with AI, so you can explore your

Let's stay in touch. Get the latest news from Google in your inbox.
Subscribe
No thanks

versions.voiceoverScript: Google 官方介绍了两项更新：Gemini Omni 与 personal avatars。官方称，Omni 可用自然语言提示，并结合照片或粗略草图生成视频。它还被描述为支持分步编辑，例如替换背景、修复光照或添加效果。Personal avatars 据官方介绍，可用自拍和短语音创建数字化身，再输入文字让它传达消息。官方同时提示，头像功能受地区、年龄、订阅和账号条件限制。生成内容会标注来源，并带有 SynthID 水印，方便识别。这是官方说明，不是实测结论。回到原文，再用真实任务验证。

sourceReferences.note: 总叙事逐幕绑定 Google 官方文章竖屏语义录屏中的八个命名窗口。

uncertainties: 上述功能、质量、稳定性和节省时间的效果均未被这些截图独立实测；旁白保留为“官方称”或“据官方介绍”。
personal avatars 的具体地区、账号资格和开放条件需要人工确认，不能推断为普遍可用。
页面中的 SynthID 说明不应延伸推断其具体验证流程或全部适用范围。
所有候选事实当前仍可能处于待人工确认状态，画面素材版权和最终可用性也需复核。

editorial.claim: 这两项更新的价值，按 Google 官方描述，在于用自然语言生成、编辑视频，并让数字化身代替本人出镜；但功能效果、稳定性和实际可用范围仍需人工确认与真实任务验证。
